rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A serverless Google Contacts server built by Offleash that provides read-only access to Google Contacts through a privacy-first OAuth 2.1 implementation deployed on AWS Lambda. The server integrates with Google's People API to offer contact listing, searching, and retrieval tools while storing only OAuth tokens (never contact data) in DynamoDB with automatic TTL cleanup. Built with Express and AWS CDK for infrastructure-as-code deployment, it features error handling, token refresh management, and support for both personal Google accounts and Google Workspace directory searches, making it useful for scheduling, communication, and relationship management tasks.
